svg.aria-label: Open Porous Media. Contributor. Community-driven open-source reservoir simulator for industrial-grade porous media simulation. I contribute to the core modules opm-common, opm-grid and opm-simulators: local grid refinement, compositional flash and dual-porosity models. Built with C++, CMake, MPI.
